From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Guardian Review: biannual check-in consolidation & OKR alignment

Team,

We need to finish the biannual check-ins and a short calibration ahead of the July 19 leadership sync. Goals for this thread:
- Consolidate manager notes into a single canonical spreadsheet (linked below).
- Highlight anyone with potential role changes, performance flags, or parental/medical leaves so we can engage People Ops confidentially.
- Confirm OKR alignment and any proposed mid-cycle corrections.

Action items: please drop your completed manager notes into the Q2 manager template by EOD July 9. If you have a sensitive case, flag it in the "sensitive" tab and send me a separate note — do NOT include details in the shared doc.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1GARDian-Q2-checkins
Template (attached): Q2_manager_notes_template.xlsx
Guidance (attached): confidential_guidelines_Q2.pdf

Notes on confidentiality: per our People Ops policy, flagged items will be handled exclusively by Jordan + Naomi + Monica. If you need to loop a skip-level, please let me know first.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan Blake
Director, Product Platforms
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Guardian Review: biannual check-in consolidation & OKR alignment

Jordan — thanks for the heads up. Quick status update from Platform Eng (Q2 team):
- Completed notes for 8 direct reports; uploaded to the shared template (sheet: platform_eng).
- Two folks I want to flag: Priyanka S. (growth expectation miss, needs 1:1 coaching) and Tom L. (consider stretch assignment rather than immediate promotion). Both are marked in the sensitive tab as requested.
- Proposed OKR tweak: drop one non-essential key result under "Latency Improvements" to reallocate time to infra resilience work.

Attaching my completed tab for convenience. If you want, I can join the calibration meeting and present the two flagged cases (I recommend private prep with Naomi first).

Attachments: platform_eng_July7_filled.xlsx

- Can we confirm the calibration slot? I proposed July 15 at 3pm in the leadership calendar but can shift if needed.
- For the OKR tweak, I agree with deprioritizing that KR, but let’s capture the change in the OKR doc and notify downstream teams.

Also: Monica, can you confirm People Ops' preference for documentation retention on flagged cases (Naomi and Jordan will retain the sensitive notes per policy, correct)?

Appreciate the quick turn. Final notes and plan: 
1) Calibration meeting confirmed: July 15, 3:00–3:45pm PT — calendar invite sent to leadership. If you cannot make it, record a 5-minute voice note and drop it in the drive folder.
2) Naomi/Monica: please confirm that sensitive tabs will be exported into our HR case tracker and retained per policy (Naomi, Monica, can you reply-all to confirm when done).
3) OKRs: Vivek, go ahead and update the OKR doc and add a short "change rationale" paragraph. Notify PMs + Eng managers by July 13.
4) Deliverables: consolidated spreadsheet (final) in Drive by EOD July 14. I will produce a 1-page executive summary for the July 19 leadership sync.

Liz — thank you for standing by. If we need outside calibration support for the two sensitive cases, I'll follow up directly.

Attachments: executive_summary_template.docx
Related: JIRA HR-904
